caption: The drawing features two detailed graphite or pencil renderings of a spoon on a beige or light tan paper background. The upper depiction shows the spoon from a top view, displaying its smooth, rounded bowl and a narrow handle that gradually widens and flattens at the end, with a subtle central ridge. The lower depiction shows the spoon from the underside, with engraved or stamped marks visible along the handle near the end; the end of the handle also displays inscribed capital letters arranged vertically ("LGM" over "D.C."). Both spoons are shaded to show three-dimensional form and reflective quality. In the bottom center, there is a rectangular inset with precise technical measurements of the spoon's outline and dimensions, labeled with fractions and inch marks. Handwritten text and a signature appear near the lower right corner, along with "SCALE ¼"=1"." The overall composition is clean and technical, focusing on accurate representation of the spoon from two perspectives with an additional dimensioned diagram.
title: Silver Spoon
